intended_actions: Limit this phase to source-backed interaction planning; no implementation under the READ_ONLY contract.
Identify the concrete element, state transitions and input interaction before selecting spring parameters; do not invent a drawer or redesign the page.
Preserve Blade/plain JS/CSS, existing styling and polling. Use existing motion support if later supplied; justify and obtain scoped dependency authorization before adding a package.

Define spring state as current position plus velocity; retarget continuously from that state, allow reversal during motion and never lock input until an animation completes. Start tuning with critical damping (ratio 1) where overshoot has no interaction purpose.
If the approved target is draggable, plan 1:1 tracking with preserved grab offset, pointer capture/cancel handling, release velocity handoff, appropriate snap projection and bounded edge resistance.
Include keyboard/single-pointer alternatives, focus continuity and prefers-reduced-motion behavior within the selected interaction. Prefer transform/opacity and bounded per-frame work.

When a safe running target is separately available, observe repeated retargeting, mid-flight reversal, drag cancel/capture, boundaries, keyboard and reduced motion in a real browser before claiming success.

قدم بعدی، مشخص‌کردن عنصر و تعامل هدف است؛ سپس حرکت باید از موقعیت و سرعت لحظه‌ای ادامه پیدا کند تا تغییر مقصد یا معکوس‌کردن آن وسط حرکت، پرش و توقف اجباری ایجاد نکند. برای drag، حفظ نقطهٔ گرفتن، pointer capture/cancel، انتقال سرعت رهاسازی و رفتار مرزها لازم است. حالت کاهش حرکت و کنترل با صفحه‌کلید نیز باید در نظر گرفته شود.
